text:
emma (Product): Morning — quick sync. I want to kick off a "seed cohort" engagement playbook for our next private/Dedicated features. Goal: recruit 6 design partners for a 10-week focused pilot. Need alignment on selection criteria, feedback loops, incentives, and launch success metrics.

melissa (BizDev): Love it. Timeline?/recruit by when? and what's the bar for partners?

emma (Product): Prefer an April kickoff. Selection: production inference use case, security/compliance needs, willingness to sign NDA + commit to weekly feedback calls and a 3-hour onboarding session.

lucas (Solutions Eng): Ops question — Dedicated vs Private mix? I suggest 2 Dedicated, 4 Private so we validate both stacks. Also we should gate features behind feature flags.

nate (Eng): We can do feature flags + canary routing. I'll spin up a quickstart repo with a one-command deploy. Example bootstrap:

```
./setup.sh --region eu-west --deploy sample
```

I'll own that repo.

sofia (Legal): NDA template looks fine but add telemetry opt-in + delete-on-exit language. I'll PR edits.

raj (Research): Feedback loops: propose 3 channels — weekly triage call, structured bi-weekly survey, and a dedicated lightweight Slack bug channel. Also collect partner prompt sets + evals to track regressions.

melissa (BizDev): :thumbsup: Can we incentivize with credits? Thinking $5k platform credits + priority support.

emma (Product): Budget ok. Proposed acceptance criteria: 1) partner integrates with the API for 2+ workflows; 2) >=95% pass on partner-specific evals (baseline); 3) documented ROI / qualitative impact for partner.

lucas (Solutions Eng): I'll draft a sample eval suite and per-workflow checklist.

nate (Eng): One partner flagged on-prem requirement. Ops, can we support on-prem for one partner?

ops-bot: Created onboarding doc: https://confluence/redwood/seed-cohort-onboard (ticket #3456)

jane (Ops): We can do a limited on-prem package but need a 4-week lead time and an SRE runbook. KMS/HSM access will be required.

sofia (Legal): Confirming: legal sign-off required for any on-prem contracts and for telemetry config.

emma (Product): Action items: @lucas draft evals by Mon, @nate create quickstart repo by Wed, @sofia push NDA edits by Fri, @melissa finalize incentives + outreach list by Tue. I'll draft cohort invite messaging and run the first outreach.

melissa (BizDev): I'll target outreach to: AcmeFin, HealthAI, Searchly, CortexLabs, OmniDocs, BrightRetail.

raj (Research): Small note — keep cohort small so we can iterate fast. Recommend max 6 partners.

lucas (Solutions Eng): Agree. Also we should build a simple success dashboard per partner (token cost, p50/p95 latency, error rates, eval score).

emma (Product): Great. If no objections I'll post the invite draft and schedule a kickoff for 2280002000 (Wed).

nate (Eng): +1

sofia (Legal): +1

melissa (BizDev): On it.

(End of thread)
